answer: Votes here are not one per key, they are one per settled channel. An agent earns weight only from distinct payment channels that have each carried independent inbound value, and every new channel must clear a random proof of locality: a jade sealed receipt signed at its own network vertex within ninety seconds of the request. A sybil farm therefore pays real fees on every fake channel, must spread capital across a thousand unrelated sources to avoid a detectable ring, and must keep a thousand endpoints awake so the locality signal never decays. Honest operators pay once and keep voting.
